TRANSACTION - FUNCTIONAL DESCRIPTION: Modifies a pricing rule that is being used for payments on EVA platform
EXECUTION FLOWS - DETAILED DESCRIPTION: Obtains the ABKOR001 service library and reads the audit user identifier from the USERCODE request header. Invokes executePutPricingRules with pricingRuleId, pricingRuleRequest and the audit user identifier. The library retrieves the existing pricing rule and its details from the database, assigns the existing pricing rule type to the request, and validates whether the rule can be modified according to its active flag, status, synchronized children and effective start date. It then checks for functional duplicates and payment-method overlaps. Optional comments, precedence type and progressive type are inherited from the existing rule when they are absent from the request. Detail values are resolved from the database. For a synchronized rule, a new PAU version is created with the original rule as parent; otherwise, details are synchronized and the existing rule is updated to PAU. The modified pricing rule is assigned to pricingRuleResponse. PricingRuleException instances are converted into advices, and the transaction assigns EWR severity when advices exist.

Accessed Libraries.Method: executePutPricingRules(Long pricingRuleId, PricingRuleDTO pricingRule, String auditUserId)
Accessed Libraries.Description: Modifies an existing pricing rule, validating its state and uniqueness, resolving detail values, synchronizing details and creating a new version when the existing rule is synchronized.
